body.segment: A relaxor ferroelectric polymer poly(vinylidene fluoride-trifluoroethylene-chlorofloroethylene) exhibits a high relative dielectric constant (k) (~60).
The high-k polymer is used successfully in solution processable low-voltage OTFTs as the gate insulator for the first time.
Both n-channel and p-channel OTFTs based on conjugated polymers are fabricated and show carrier mobilities higher than 0.1 cm2 V-1 s-1 at an operating voltage of 3 V.
